items.name: Ideal.mem_span_singleton'
items.type: {α : Type u} [Semiring α] {x y : α} : x ∈ Ideal.span {y} ↔ ∃ a, a * y = x

items.name: Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite
items.type: {α : Type u} [Semiring α] (s : Set α) : Ideal.span s = ⊤ ↔ ∃ s', ↑s' ⊆ s ∧ Ideal.span ↑s' = ⊤

items.name: Ideal.mem_span_pair
items.type: {α : Type u} [Semiring α] {x y z : α} : z ∈ Ideal.span {x, y} ↔ ∃ a b, a * x + b * y = z

items.name: Ideal.mem_span_insert
items.type: {α : Type u} [Semiring α] {s : Set α} {x y : α} : x ∈ Ideal.span (insert y s) ↔ ∃ a, ∃ z ∈ Ideal.span s, x = a * y + z

items.name: Ideal.mem_span_insert'
items.type: {α : Type u} [Ring α] (x y : α) (s : Set α) : x ∈ Ideal.span (insert y s) ↔ ∃ a, x + a * y ∈ Ideal.span s
